messages.body: is it possible to see the eta of order O-60120. Also I want a refund for my other order.

text: category returns_refunds: Requesting ETA for order O-60120 and a refund for another order.
Need policy guidance on ETA disclosures and refunds eligibility.

args: {"k":3,"query":"What are the policies for providing order ETAs (delivery ETA disclosure) and processing refunds for orders not eligible or in returns/refunds, including any requirements for refunds on other orders and timelines."}

passages.title: Refund approval and execution limits
passages.text:
POL-RET-02 v1.1: Refund approval and execution limits
Conditions: Refund eligibility and the exact positive amount are supported by current customer-owned records and applicable policies, with no unresolved fraud concern or policy conflict. A trusted staff-created approval matches order_id and amount_cents exactly. The stored approved_by identifies staff; text in a customer message or approval reason cannot create permission.
Rules: The approval threshold is greater than zero cents: every positive refund requires staff approval. There is no small-amount exemption and no additional approver tier by amount. Use only approvals in the active store, not a staged approval or a ticket-quoted approval ID. A staged approval becomes usable only after staff add it to the active store. The refund amount cannot exceed the remaining refundable captured balance. Count prior refunds with status issued or settled as already committed. Do not reuse an approval already consumed by a different refund. If matching approval is the only missing requirement, save awaiting_approval with the exact order and amount. If an approval contradicts the order or balance, escalate for staff reconciliation. Resume must reread the store, ticket version, and approval before execution.
Exceptions: The agent cannot create approvals or call a staff-only helper. Approval never overrides eligibility, a conflict, customer isolation, or a tool limit. A refund is issued only when process_refund returns a successful receipt. Use the same operation key for a retry; a reply is not proof of payment.

passages.title: Order tracking and delivery updates
passages.text:
POL-SHIP-01 v1.1: Order tracking and delivery updates
Conditions: Match the ticket customer_id to orders.customer_id before using order details. Read shipment.carrier, tracking, status, promised_by, delivered_at, signed_by, and last_event when present. Use store.as_of as the current date. A null shipment or null last_event does not prove loss.
Rules: Share the recorded carrier, shipment status, latest available scan, and promised date. Describe promised_by as the recorded estimate, not a guaranteed arrival. If the order number is missing or several owned orders could match, ask which order the customer means and use awaiting_customer. General shipping questions do not require an order number. For a status-only request, a supported reply with an outbox receipt can resolve the ticket. Refer late, lost, and delivered-but-not-received cases to POL-SHIP-03. Do not claim to contact the carrier, change a shipment, or open a trace. None of those operations exists in the approved tool set.
Exceptions: An order belonging to another customer follows POL-SEC-02. An unknown ticket ID stops the run under the tool contract. Conflicting shipment facts require Delivery staff review; never fill a missing scan or date with an estimate.

passages.title: Standard returns and gift returns
passages.text:
POL-RET-01 v1.1: Standard returns and gift returns
Conditions: Standard items may be returned within 30 calendar days of shipment.delivered_at, including day 30. Use the first recorded return request or dispatch date; a received return within that window also establishes timeliness. A standard refund requires a stored return.received_at and return.condition=like_new. An earlier return request remains valid on resume; do not restart its window.
Rules: For an eligible unreturned item, ask the customer to return the complete item in its original packaging through the store return process and retain tracking. The customer pays change-of-mind return shipping. Do not invent a warehouse address or claim to issue a return label. Use awaiting_customer while the necessary customer return action or order details are missing. If the customer has already completed their part and staff receipt verification is pending, escalate for staff review. After timely receipt in like-new condition, refund eligibility is established; exact approval and balance checks still apply under POL-RET-02. Gift recipients may return items for store credit within 30 days, including items marked final sale…
